claim: A destructive action can only be approved by echoing back the exact SHA-256 of the plan that was shown — a "yes" with no hash is rejected.

steps.label: the operator echoes the exact hash of the plan shown
steps.result:
executed: DROP TABLE toy_customers;
DELETE FROM toy_orders WHERE 1=1;
steps.evidence: provided value equals the shown plan's SHA-256

steps.label: a bare "yes" carries no evidence of what was approved

steps.note: Consent has to name what was consented to.
